description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 27.06.2016 to 03.07.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Customs Ordinance, specifically setting and announcing new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It involves the exercise of statutory powers by the Director General of Customs to determine these rates, which falls under legal/regulatory framework adjustments rather than government personnel changes, organisational restructuring, or any other specialized category.
